card.title: My Sponsor Inside
card.instruction: Treat one person as your sponsor inside the system. Seek their introductions and approval while resisting the identity their support assigns you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Please get me into the club, but don't tell them you rescued me.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly. A signature, not a creation story.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It asks how I know you.

mechanism: A needs the club sponsor's signature but controls how that sponsor describes the relationship so support does not become a rescue story.
confusable: Unlike refusing help altogether, A accepts gate-opening sponsorship while resisting its implied subordinate identity.
comparison: The application alternative constrains a required relationship field; the committee alternative admits the introduction must precede independent credibility.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
